checked_profile.summary: A broker for comparing insurance quotes and working with licensed agents.
checked_profile.scope: Broker role, quote support and pricing responsibility. This is not an insurer review or a verification of every policy available through the platform.

facts.label: Broker, not issuing insurer
facts.text: Policygenius identifies itself as a licensed independent insurance broker. It is not the insurance company underwriting the policy you buy through it.

facts.label: Quotes and help
facts.text: The platform offers free tailored quotes and support from licensed agents. Its displayed premium quotes and ranges are non-binding.

facts.label: Who sets the final price?
facts.text: The underwriting insurance company determines the final policy premium after application. Coverage limits, exam requirements, riders and financial-strength ratings must be checked for the actual insurer and product, not assigned to the broker as one universal offer.
